author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes: 1.9.5 - a new Export JSON button (next to Device icons) downloads the whole map as one structured, self-describing JSON file - every device, app, relationship, external system, Hub Variable and decoded rule flowchart, an orientation block explaining the schema up front, and precomputed findings (contested devices, unreferenced devices, inert apps, broken rule references). Built for an AI or other external tool to read: relationships join on stable ids, not display names (this hub has real duplicate app names, which would otherwise make some relationships ambiguous or, for rule flows, silently overwrite one another). Fixed a real, longstanding bug surfaced while building this: a non-inert child app's own parent-app id was never recorded, only a container's list of its children - app hierarchy now reads correctly both directions. Also: automatic daily scan is on by default now (00:30, still easily turned off); the legend moved to the top of the screen and no longer overlaps the device/app counter; and the four floating panels (Insights, External systems, Pivot tables, Device icons) now always bring whichever was opened most recently to the front, instead of whichever happened to load later in the page.
